subject.title: fix(memory-wiki): propagate deadline signal and skip exhaustive fallback for supplement search

question: Should memory-wiki corpus supplements be allowed to return partial digest-routed results instead of exhaustively backfilling when the digest underfills?
rationale: This changes an existing plugin fallback and result-completeness behavior; source review can verify the implementation but cannot decide whether maintainers accept that user-visible compatibility tradeoff.

options.title: Adopt bounded supplements
options.body: Accept partial digest-routed supplement results within the deadline while retaining exhaustive behavior for explicit `wiki_search`.

options.title: Preserve exhaustive recall
options.body: Keep supplement backfill and instead make enumeration, reads, and parsing fully abort-aware under the deadline.

recommendation.title: Adopt bounded supplements
recommendation.body: Accept partial digest-routed supplement results within the deadline while retaining exhaustive behavior for explicit `wiki_search`.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced both the supplement bridge and digest retrieval behavior whose contract is being changed.
